schema: Array of {name, type, parts:[{part, slash, strike, shooting, fire, water, thunder, ice, dragon}]}

roster.note: Roster is the 51 large monsters listed by the MH3U source. Small monsters are intentionally excluded. The source labels Purple Ludroth as 'Pink Ludroth'; the official English name is used here.

hitzoneSources.name: MH3U/3G Monster Details (mhkita.com)
hitzoneSources.usedFor: Primary numeric damage charts and explicit condition labels for 49 monsters; also used for Alatreon because Kiranico has no numeric Alatreon table.
hitzoneSources.notes: Each page has a Damage Chart with Condition labels (All Conditions, Normal/Rage, G rank, Hardened/Softened, Covered/Uncovered, Fish out, elemental states). Column order on these pages is Cut, Impact, Shooting, Fire, Water, Thunder, Ice, Dragon. Values were copied as integers. Faint/Stagger columns were not used.

hitzoneSources.name: Kiranico MH3U monster pages
hitzoneSources.usedFor: Cross-check of part coverage and values; Hallowed Jhen Mohran values because the mhkita copy transposes Thunder/Ice and contains an uncorroborated negative Fire value on Neck.
hitzoneSources.notes: Kiranico column order is Cut, Impact, Shot, Fire, Water, Ice, Thunder, Dragon, so Ice/Thunder were reordered when comparing. Kiranico has no numeric chart for Dire Miralis and no numeric chart for Alatreon; Alatreon therefore uses mhkita only.

hitzoneSources.name: Monster Hunter Wiki - Dire Miralis (MH3U) / Outdated
hitzoneSources.usedFor: Dire Miralis hitzones only, because the primary MH3U sources have no numeric table for it.
hitzoneSources.notes: MH3U-specific numeric Hit Zone Values table: Cut, Impact, Bullet, Fire, Water, Thunder, Ice, Dragon. This is the archived/outdated version of the wiki page; the current page has an empty damage table. Values were not invented; they are copied from this published table.

crossCheck.summary: Kiranico values agree with mhkita for the large majority of parts after reordering Kiranico's Ice/Thunder columns. Where they disagree, mhkita was kept except Hallowed Jhen Mohran, which uses Kiranico. Differences are usually small and are recorded below for auditability.

discrepancies.kiranico: normal front 25/25/20 and back 25/25/30; charged front 22/22/25 and back 25/25/25

notes: No MH4U values or monsters are included; this file is MH3U-only.

Suffixes follow the existing MHFU data conventions so the current MonsterMatchups code can distinguish normal, -enraged, -post-break, -harden, -guard, and -brokenshell states. Additional descriptive suffixes (-g-rank, -fished, -ice-mode) are kept because the source distinguishes those states; unrecognized suffixes are treated as normal by the current code.
Trailing -enraged is used for both Rage and Zinogre 'Super charged' states because both represent the powered-up state used by the 'Include enraged' option.

Dire Miralis is the only monster whose hitzones come from the Monster Hunter Wiki outdated MH3U table; mhkita and Kiranico both lack a numeric chart for it. Its Back/Tail values are combined in the source and are stored as the single part back-tail.
Official English monster names were used; the only roster label corrected was mhkita's 'Pink Ludroth' -> 'Purple Ludroth'.
